text: On 2026-03-19, $38,000.00 left the payment account of Meridian Dental Institute, passed through two accounts with no registered owner, and returned to the very same account eight days later as $32,163.20 - a three-hop cycle losing 15.4% along the way. Money that comes back to its origin has not paid for anything; routed through unowned shell accounts on a schedule this tight, it is the signature of recycled payouts dressed up as turnover. Any one transfer looks like an ordinary settlement, but a closed loop through shells within a single week is not how clinics pay suppliers or refund insurers. A legitimate reading would be an intra-group treasury sweep, but honest group accounts carry registered owners and these two do not. Next step: identify the holders of the two shell accounts and request the transfer mandates behind all three movements.
